source.command: python -m pytest tests/test_codex_adapter.py tests/test_antigravity_adapter.py tests/test_antigravity_smoke.py tests/test_operator.py -q

claims.claim: Codex PRIMARY native execution is deterministically identified as the already-selected native Executor role and instructed/structured to implement the supplied TASK directly without entering any Human-facing worker or AIOS operator dispatch path.

Codex REMEDIATION and REPAIR native executions receive the same already-admitted Executor-role boundary and directly execute only their supplied remediation/repair authority without invoking Human-facing worker or operator launchers.

Antigravity PRIMARY, REMEDIATION, and REPAIR handoffs preserve semantic parity with Codex: the native worker is already the selected Executor, performs the authorized HOW directly, and does not re-enter Human/operator dispatch.
Existing one-Human-authorization/one-native-Executor invocation semantics are preserved with no added retry, reroute, fallback, recursive dispatch, or second native invocation.

Existing TASK-045 mutation-truth behavior remains authoritative: CODE_FIX requires non-empty authorized committed delta advancing HEAD, while EVIDENCE_ONLY and NO_CHANGE retain existing zero-mutation behavior.
Runtime continues to own canonical verification and EVIDENCE for PRIMARY, REMEDIATION, and REPAIR; native Executors receive no new canonical verification authority.
TASK-048 remote remediation-lineage behavior, Direct Candidate Acceptance, review/remediation discovery, finding identity, and admission diagnostics are unchanged.

Deterministic tests cover native execution-role separation without asserting exact natural-language prompt wording or implementation spelling, and existing Codex/Antigravity structural output and failure behavior remains green.
No frozen kernel schema, downstream worker protocol, downstream dependency pin, historical artifact, review authority, publication rule, or product/domain repository semantics are changed.

The final implementation is a narrow AIOS-renew execution-boundary hardening sufficient to prevent the RUN-125-007 class of native-executor/operator-role confusion without creating another orchestration layer or weakening fail-closed completion semantics.
